messages:
mira: quick sync — running a short experiment across the pricing page this sprint. focus: tier naming, faq microcopy, calculator UX, and webinar CTA routing for inbound. want small, fast wins we can iterate on.

kyle: love it. can we prioritize tier naming + calc? those move conversion fastest.

lucy: agree. also suggest a tiny 'benchmark blurb' near the top with 1-line latency/cost claim we can A/B. keeps credibility without clutter.

daan: inbound routing note — plan to tag leads in HubSpot with variant keys so sales gets variant context. can wire mapping once keys are final.

mira: proposed variant keys: tier_short, tier_descriptive, tier_badges. calc variants: slider_compact, slider_detailed.

adele: FAQ microcopy guidance: answers <= 2 lines, include a single CTA to full docs, and one example prompt for the calculator. sample: "How is my estimate calculated? We multiply tokens by model rate — try the estimator with your prompt to see runtime cost." :memo:

kyle: measurement plan — 1 week A/B (30/30/40 split), track: demo clicks, signups, qualified leads, and calc-interaction rate. capture time-on-page for calc flows.

lucy: i'll design the webinar CTA / modal: capture email + use-case + a 'used calculator' checkbox to help SDRs. modal should be non-blocking on first load.

marketing-bot: created task in GH: MKT-5423 pricing-experiments (https://github.com/redwood/mkt/issues/5423) :white_check_mark: 

mira: next steps: lucy -> CTA + modal mock by Tue EOD; daan -> hubspot tag mapping by Wed; kyle -> analytics funnel + events; adele -> draft FAQ microcopy. check-in Friday 10am. :calendar:

kyle: i'll stub GA/amplitude events: pricing.calc_interaction, pricing.tier_variant, pricing.webinar_cta_click. will share event spec in #analytics.

daan: hubspot mapping snippet i'll use: 
```
UTM -> hubspot property: pricing_experiment_variant
values: tier_short|tier_descriptive|tier_badges|slider_compact|slider_detailed
```

mira: small copy ask — avoid 'commit' or 'locked in' phrasing for tier_badges variant so we can test trust vs. urgency effects.

lucy: got it. keeping copy neutral & benefit-first. :rocket:

kyle: anything else? otherwise i'll set up the experiment scaffold and open the tracking ticket.

mira: that’s it for now. thanks team — short loop, fast learn.
